title: Dinosaur Quiz
description: Roar! How much do you know about the amazing dinosaurs that once ruled the Earth?

questions.question: What does the name 'Dinosaur' mean?
questions.explanation: The word 'dinosaur' comes from Greek – 'deinos' means terrible and 'sauros' means lizard! 🦎

questions.question: Which was the largest meat-eating dinosaur?
questions.explanation: Spinosaurus was even bigger than T-Rex! It could grow up to 18 metres long and loved to eat fish. 🐟

questions.question: What did the Triceratops use its three horns for?
questions.explanation: Triceratops used its three sharp horns to defend itself against predators like T-Rex. It was like a rhino of its time! 🦏

questions.question: Which dinosaur had the longest neck?
questions.explanation: Brachiosaurus had an incredibly long neck to reach leaves high up in the treetops – like a giant giraffe! 🦒

questions.question: How did most dinosaurs reproduce?
questions.explanation: Dinosaurs laid eggs just like modern birds and reptiles! Some nests have been found with many eggs inside. 🥚

questions.question: What are birds considered to be?
questions.explanation: Birds evolved from theropod dinosaurs! So when you see a sparrow, you're looking at a tiny living dinosaur. 🐦

questions.question: How long ago did the dinosaurs go extinct?
questions.explanation: A massive asteroid hit Earth about 66 million years ago and wiped out most dinosaurs. That's a very long time ago! ☄️
